title: Classic Southern Gumbo
description: A rich, dark roux-based gumbo with andouille sausage, shrimp, and okra. Comfort food at its finest.
instructions: Whisk flour and oil over medium heat for 30–45 minutes until the roux turns chocolate brown.
Add onion, celery, and bell pepper; cook until soft, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and sausage; cook 3 minutes.
Pour in stock, bring to a boil, then reduce and simmer 45 minutes.
Add okra and shrimp; cook 8 minutes until shrimp are pink.
Season and serve over white rice.
notes: The darker the roux, the richer the flavor — don't rush it.

title: Pimento Cheese
description: Rich, creamy, and just a little spicy. The quintessential Southern snack for holidays and gatherings.
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl.
Mix until creamy and well combined.
Serve with crackers, celery, or bread.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
description: A Thanksgiving staple — sweet, buttery, topped with a pecan streusel that makes it almost count as dessert.
ingredients: Topping: 1 cup brown sugar, ⅓ cup flour, ⅓ cup butter, 1 cup chopped pecans
instructions: Mix sweet potatoes, sugar, eggs, salt, butter, milk, and vanilla.
Pour into a buttered casserole dish.
Combine topping ingredients and spread over sweet potato mixture.
Bake 30 minutes until topping is browned and set.
notes: Can be prepared a day ahead and refrigerated before baking.
